* who lives in a pineapple
under the sea? *

* absorbent and yellow
and porous is he. *

* if nautical nonsense be
something you wish... *

* then drop on the deck
and flop like a fish. *

Mind your wandering eye,
you little mollusk.
I don't have a driver's license.
I sure take a good picture.

Darn! I should have
grown a moustache.

How could i have forgotten the
most important rule of driving?

Hey! I can see
the krusty krab from here.

I finally got
my driver's license.

Not even in your dreams,
mr. Squarepants.

I'm going to get
a closer look.
Wow, look at all these books.

In dreams, one is not tethered
by earthly limitations.

For ages, dreams
have been thought of

"Let me not mar
that perfect dream
"There once was a man from peru

"Who dreamed he was
eating his shoe

"He woke with a fright
in the middle of the night

To find that his dream
had come true."

Gee, Gary,
you sure are smart.

Did you think
my shell was
full of hot air?

I'm going back
to my own dream.

Beware of your wandering eye,
you little poriferan.

You know, Patrick,
this is a dream.

You can do
anything you want.

Watch-- I can turn
into a skyscraper.

I'm going to
a different dream.
Oh, this is going to be good!

Why do you stop playing,
wolfgang amadeus tentacles?

Hey, i have not
instructed you to stop!

About the man
from peru again.

I came here to hear
beautiful music.

If i don't get my wish,
it'll be your head!

ever so.

I fear that my tears
might stain my petticoat.

Thank you,
thank you, thank you.

Hey, Spongebob,
what brings you here?

And we'll land
on that itty-Bitty target.

a big, old parachute.

No more messing
with people's dreams.

for the tea party.

I was looking
for your dad's dream.

sophistication of tea parties.

I bet Mister Krabs's dream
will be more robust.

I got you now,
you slippery demon!

You're putting up
a good fight.

I'm talking about
cold, hard, flipping cash!

I got her--
Here she comes.

Never mind
the small change, lad.

Wow! You look real good

Get it, Spongebob,
get it, get it!

This'll make a great
fish story, eh, Mister Krabs?

Hey, plankton's dreaming
about bikini bottom.

Oh, look,
it's the krusty krab

I think
he's got the point.

Well, i guess i've got
some explaining to do, huh?
Ah, that was fun and all

But it's good to be back
in my own dream cloud.
What do you want from me?

Hey! What are
you all doing
in your pajamas?

Are we having
a slumber party?

No, we are not having
a slumber party.

Do us all
a favor, Spongebob

And stay out
of our dreams.

Don't we get enough
of you during the day?

A quick midnight snack,
and then it's back to bed.

Ah, sleep tight,
my little angel.

Nothing like a sea-Nut butter
and jellyfish jelly sandwich
To help you get to sleep.

Oh, Gary,
i don't feel like myself.

If i had the suds, i'd have
bubbles coming out of me.

Because then
i'll have to miss work.

I like wearing
my underwear like this.

Spongebob,
what's holding up
those patties?

You're paler
than a baby sea horse.

Here's that patty
you wanted, Mister Krabs, sir.

All right, Spongebob,
you're too sick to work.
No, Mister Krabs, i'm okay, honest.

No, now go home
and get some rest.

I just can't have you sneezing
all over my food.
Oh, who am i kidding, Gary?

I've got the suds,
no doubt about it.

I better take care of this
before it gets out of hand.

Can you escort me

I'll be there faster

On a hot greasy griddle

who knows a guy

to the doctor once

a horrible, horrible place.

It can't be
as horrible as the suds.

Well, first they make you
sit in the... waiting room.

Is that the horrible part,
Patrick?

They make you read
old magazines.

Then the doctor pulls out
his stethoscope.

So icy cold
when it touches
your bare flesh

Patrick, i don't want
to go the doctor.

You got to help me
get better, Patrick.

Would you like to be
my doctor, Patrick?

We'll have to plug up
these holes.

This ought to do
the trick.

At this rate
i'll be cured in no time.

In fact, i'm going
to call Sandy

And tell her
not to come.

And they said i'd never make
anything out of myself.

My fingers are too big
for the buttons.

Dr. Patrick,
could you call Sandy for me?

I'm calling on behalf
of my patient, Spongebob.

To take him
to the hospital.

Uh... uh... that will
no longer be required.

He is in my care
as of today.

Well, i'm coming over
to take a look.

I'll be over there
faster than a barefoot
jackrabbit on a hot...

We've got to make
sure you're well

Or she'll take you
to the doctor.

Patrick, sometimes
i just don't understand you.

Uh... uh...
he's not here at the moment.

Please leave a message
after the beep.

Since when do you
have two houses?

Since i ran out of space
to put my stuff.

Since when
does your house have feet?

Hmm, the dirt therapy
seems to be working
just fine.

Patrick, Spongebob has to see
a real doctor.

See? He's even worse
than i thought.

I'm taking you
to the doctor
right now.

You can't take him
to the doctor's.

Now look what
you've done, Patrick.

Everything was fine
until you showed up.

You should be arrested
for impersonating
a doctor.

Well, mr. Squarepants,
it seems you have the suds.

Are you ready
for your treatment?

You're not going
to make me

No, silly, you get
the sponge treatment.
I feel as good as new.
Hey, doc, i got the suds, too.

We have a special
treatment for you.
